# Vessel

> Vessel is an open-source, Git-backed documentation layer for humans and AI agents. It turns Markdown and OpenAPI into a readable docs site, compact agent indexes, and an MCP-ready surface that teams can self-host.

## Product

- [Platform overview](/#platform): One source that compiles to human docs, llms.txt, and MCP surfaces.
- [Agent layer](/#agent-layer): Repo-native instructions, typed tools, runnable examples, and feedback loops.
- [AI Assistant](/#assistant-studio): Bring OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, or a custom OpenAI-compatible key to a private assistant gateway.
- [Docs index](/docs/): Browse the generated human-readable source index.
- [Docs API](/api/docs/index): Discover pages, then search the indexed Markdown source or retrieve complete source-grounded pages.
- [Docs audit](/api/docs/audit): Check freshness, metadata, examples, navigation, and internal links before publishing.
- [API reference](/api/): Browse the generated OpenAPI reference and use the no-network request-preview playground.
- [API operation index](/api/openapi/index): Retrieve the OpenAPI-derived operation map, examples, security, parameters, and responses.
- [Agent manifest](/agent-manifest.json): Discover versions, locales, capabilities, constraints, surfaces, and page provenance.
- [Agent permissions](/agent-permissions.json): Read-only access contract; writes require human approval.
- [Agent skill](/skill.md): Step-by-step workflow for coding and support agents.
- [MCP endpoint](/api/mcp): Read-only JSON-RPC tools and resources for docs search, page retrieval, runnable examples, API operation discovery, and API operation retrieval.
- [Maintenance](/#maintenance): Detect code, product, support, visual, and semantic drift; explain changes; and hold generated patches for review.
- [Deployment](/#deploy): Deploy with Cloudflare Workers, Netlify, or any static host.
- [Source and setup](/#source): Open-source project direction and starter command.
- [Getting started](https://github.com/everyai-com/mintly-alternative/blob/main/GETTING_STARTED.md): Clone, configure, verify, and deploy Vessel in a few minutes.

## Concepts

- [Human docs](/#demo): Searchable, readable documentation for people.
- [Agent index](/#demo): A concise llms.txt map and a full context export for smaller context windows.
- [MCP gateway](/#demo): Discoverable resources and safe, typed tools for MCP clients.
- [Git-first workflow](/#agent-layer): Markdown, OpenAPI, examples, and agent instructions reviewed together.
- [Knowledge operations](/#maintenance): Hybrid Git/visual editing, support-gap mining, API contract linting, approvals, and audit history.
- [Knowledge surfaces](/#maintenance): Public docs, customer help center, private wiki, and embedded help can share one indexed source.
- [GitHub connection](/github): One-click providers can clone the public GitHub source; an optional GitHub App can scope repository sync.

## Deployment

- [Cloudflare Workers deployment](/#deploy): Use the live Deploy to Cloudflare button for `everyai-com/mintly-alternative`.
- [Netlify deployment](/#deploy): Use the live Netlify deploy button or connect the repository for continuous deploys.
- [Self-hosted build](/#deploy): Run npm run build and serve the generated dist directory.
